plan.change: Phase C3-1: add base-owned verification evidence workflow and align executable-bit risk/impact re-evaluation
expectedChanges: Add a pull_request_target verification evidence workflow that uses trusted base tools and treats candidate content only as data.
Bind trusted mechanical evidence to exact base/head SHA and GitHub workflow run metadata without declaring full VERIFIED yet.
Pass Git executable-mode information into verification Risk and Impact re-evaluation so README or other low-risk-looking paths cannot downgrade executable changes.
Add regression coverage for the trusted workflow boundary and executable-bit verification behavior.
hqDecisions: C3-1 does not introduce Verification Record v0.3 or human attestation; it only establishes trusted runner evidence and executable-bit parity.
The new verification workflow must not self-certify while candidate-only; the existing base-owned Change PR Gate reviews this Change OS modification before merge.
Candidate code is not executed by the C3-1 verification evidence workflow; trusted base tools inspect the candidate checkout as data.
rulesApplied: Phase C C2 trusted evidence contract
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: C3-1 changes Change OS tooling/workflows only; correctness is exercised by regression tests, the existing trusted PR gate, and a post-merge canary.
plan.rollback: Revert the C3-1 PR from staging; the existing Change PR Gate remains the trusted admission gate and production is untouched.
outOfScope: Trusted static-check registry and candidate test execution
Phase E semantic scope and concurrency controls
unverified: The new verification evidence workflow requires a post-merge canary because pull_request_target uses the base branch workflow.
C3-1 evidence is trusted mechanical gate evidence only and must not yet be called final VERIFIED.
plan.problem: C1 found that Verification has no base-owned trusted runner and that executable Git mode is considered by the PR Risk Gate but omitted from Verification Risk/Impact re-evaluation.
plan.currentContract: Plan Lock, repository identity and exact verified SHA are checked, but Verification evidence can be produced locally/candidate-side and evaluateVerification calls Risk/Impact without executablePaths.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: A candidate can produce a structurally valid local verification result, and a 100755 change to a low-risk-looking path can be high-risk in the PR gate but lower-risk during Verification.
plan.design: Introduce a pull_request_target workflow loaded from the trusted base that verifies the locked Plan, checks candidate exact SHA as data, runs trusted Scope/Risk/Impact tools, and emits structured run-bound evidence. In parallel, thread collectExecutablePaths through Verification and Impact evaluation so all gates use the same executable-path information.
alternativesRejected: Let the candidate branch define or execute the verification workflow that certifies itself.
Treat free-form Verification Record strings as trusted mechanical evidence.
Bundle Record v0.3, human attestation, and trusted static-check execution into C3-1.
plan.migration: No town/runtime data migration. Existing v0.2 records remain legacy/local evidence; C3-1 adds trusted mechanical evidence without changing their schema.
plan.compatibility: Existing Change PR Gate and v0.2 verification CLI remain available. The verification evaluator gains executable-path options while preserving existing callers through default empty options.
boundaryCases: README.md changes from 100644 to 100755 and must receive unknown-code risk/impact treatment during Verification.
The new workflow exists only on the candidate branch and therefore cannot run as trusted pull_request_target code until after merge.
A candidate edits a workflow or Change OS tool; trusted evidence must still execute code from the PR base, not the candidate copy.
A PR metadata edit reruns the trusted evidence workflow against the same exact candidate SHA.
testPlan: Add Verification regression for executable README mode escalation.
Add Impact regression proving executable low-risk content derives high-risk impacts.
Assert the new workflow uses pull_request_target, trusted/candidate separate checkouts, persist-credentials false, and trusted tool paths.
Run Change Operations regression suite and node syntax through existing CI.
After merge, open a non-merge canary PR and confirm the new trusted evidence workflow emits exact-SHA evidence.
plan.promotionRisk: No production promotion. C3-1 changes staging Change OS only; a faulty workflow could affect future verification claims, so existing trusted PR gate review and post-merge canary are required.
